"""Temporal, safety-first candidate controller with bounded action hysteresis."""

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
MOTION_ACTIONS = ("FORWARD", "VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT")


def safety_contract(observation, memory):
    """Stop whenever confidence is low or collision-closing risk is high."""
    if (
        float(observation["safety_confidence"]) < 0.60
        or float(observation["closing_risk"]) >= 0.75
    ):
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
        memory["action_age"] = 0
        return "STOP", 0.99
    return None


def tracking_contract(observation, memory):
    """Use short stationary reacquisition, then bounded directional scanning."""
    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    reliable = (
        visible
        and float(observation["target_confidence"]) >= 0.55
        and float(observation["target_identity_confidence"]) >= 0.60
    )
    if reliable:
        memory["lost_steps"] = 0
        if int(observation["track_age"]) < 2:
            memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
            return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80
        return None

    lost_steps = max(int(observation["lost_steps"]), int(memory.get("lost_steps", 0)))
    memory["lost_steps"] = lost_steps
    if memory.get("state") in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "REACQUIRE"} and lost_steps <= 2:
        memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
        return "STOP", 0.92

    direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    if lost_steps % 2 == 0:
        direction = "SCAN_RIGHT" if direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
    memory["scan_direction"] = direction
    memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
    return direction, 0.75


def propose_moves(observation, memory):
    """Build unique corridor-safe proposals with a wider directional deadband."""
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    candidates = []
    if bearing < -18.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_LEFT")
    if bearing > 18.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_RIGHT")
    if observation["corridor_center"]:
        candidates.append("FORWARD")
    if observation["corridor_left"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_LEFT")
    if observation["corridor_right"]:
        candidates.append("VEER_RIGHT")
    return list(dict.fromkeys(candidates))


def progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates):
    """Select a safe proposal using bearing hysteresis and anti-oscillation memory."""
    if not candidates:
        return None

    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    previous = memory.get("last_action")
    age = int(memory.get("action_age", 0))
    preferred = None

    if abs(bearing) <= 10.0 and "FORWARD" in candidates:
        preferred = "FORWARD"
    elif bearing < -10.0 and "VEER_LEFT" in candidates:
        preferred = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 10.0 and "VEER_RIGHT" in candidates:
        preferred = "VEER_RIGHT"

    if preferred is not None:
        if (
            previous in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}
            and preferred != previous
            and age < 2
            and "FORWARD" in candidates
        ):
            preferred = "FORWARD"
        elif previous == preferred and age >= 3 and "FORWARD" in candidates and abs(bearing) < 20.0:
            preferred = "FORWARD"

    action = preferred or candidates[0]
    memory["last_action"] = action
    memory["action_age"] = 0
    return action


def termination_contract(observation, memory):
    """Return a high-confidence stationary fallback when motion is unavailable."""
    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
    memory["action_age"] = 0
    return "STOP", 0.98


def decide(observation, memory):
    """Compose safety, tracking, progress, and termination into three return values."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    memory["action_age"] = int(memory.get("action_age", 0)) + 1

    safety = safety_contract(observation, memory)
    if safety is not None:
        return safety[0], safety[1], memory

    tracking = tracking_contract(observation, memory)
    if tracking is not None:
        memory["last_action"] = tracking[0]
        memory["action_age"] = 0
        return tracking[0], tracking[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "LOCKED"
    if observation["target_distance_class"] == "near":
        if (
            abs(float(observation["heading_error"])) <= 15.0
            and float(observation["target_identity_confidence"]) >= 0.80
        ):
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            memory["last_action"] = "ARRIVED"
            memory["action_age"] = 0
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory
        candidates = [
            "VEER_LEFT"
            if float(observation["target_bearing"]) < 0.0
            else "VEER_RIGHT"
        ]
    else:
        candidates = propose_moves(observation, memory)

    action = progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates)
    if action is None:
        fallback = termination_contract(observation, memory)
        return fallback[0], fallback[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    return action, 0.90, memory


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
